resources.string: ROM dump finished — choose Download or Download & Play.
Reading ROM to the OSCR SD card…
Transfer stalled after %1$s of %2$s. The partial download was removed; reconnect the reader and retry.

1. Flash the matching OSCR serial-transfer firmware. It runs at 115,200 baud for reliable sustained transfers.

2. Insert a cartridge, connect the reader with a USB OTG cable, and tap Connect.

3. Pick the console and choose Read ROM. The OSCR writes and checksums its authoritative SD copy first.

4. At the Press Button prompt, choose Download to save only, or Download & Play to CRC-verify the USB copy and launch the emulator configured for that console.

5. Verified ROMs are saved under Downloads/CartReader/ROMs. Open existing ROM… can launch a file that is already on this device.

6. Use Emulators to select RetroArch, the Android chooser, or a specific installed app for each cartridge type.

Tip: ordinary menu commands are still sent as exact single bytes without a newline.
